name: A clip's file name and first-frame thumbnail (Bookmarks 1.7.0 / 2.5.0): on Chaptered Movie, admin's range 0:12-0:20 named 'clip-thumbs Heist' is made into an Accurate clip; its file is named '<name> - <title> [range].mp4'; GET /Bookmarks/Clips/Media lists its own Poster and Thumb; the poster, drawn in the browser beside the clip's frame 0, matches it (and the thumb matches the poster); the video page's Clips row and My Clips show the Thumb. Screenshots of both (clip-thumbs.png, myclips-thumbs.png). The bookmark and its clip are deleted at the end. Needs UseClipFirstFrameAsThumbnail on (the default).

steps.name: clips may be made, and each clip's first frame is its thumbnail (UseClipFirstFrameAsThumbnail, the default)
steps.message: this webcheck needs clips enabled for admin

steps.name: find Chaptered Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Chaptered Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the movie's clip-thumbs bookmarks of an earlier run deleted
steps.script: const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); let n = 0; for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (/^clip-thumbs/.test(b.Name || '')) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); n++; } } return n;

steps.name: a range 0:12-0:20 named 'clip-thumbs Heist'
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 120000000, EndTicks: 200000000, Name: 'clip-thumbs Heist' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' })).Id

steps.name: its clip asked for (Accurate, MP4)
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.bookmarkId + '/Clip'), data: JSON.stringify({ Mode: 'Accurate' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' })).Clip.Status

steps.name: the clip as My Clips lists it
steps.eval: ((r) => r.Items.filter((c) => String(c.Id).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase() === String(__vars.bookmarkId).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase()).map((c) => ({ ItemName: c.ItemName, FileName: c.Clip.FileName, Container: c.Clip.Container }))[0])(await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Clips', { itemId: __vars.movieId, limit: 200 })))

steps.name: the file is named with the clip's name first, then the video's title, then the range (1.7.0 / 2.5.0): 'clip-thumbs Heist - <title> [00.00.12-00.00.20].mp4'
the clip's own artwork: a Poster and a Thumb (its first frame), within 60 s
the poster against the clip's frame 0 and its last frame, and the thumb against the poster (each drawn at 64x36 in the browser; mean difference per channel, 0-255)
steps.eval: (async () => { const key = String(__vars.bookmarkId).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); const tok = ApiClient.accessToken(); const W = 64, H = 36; const pixels = (src) => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = W; c.height = H; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(src, 0, 0, W, H); return g.getImageData(0, 0, W, H).data; }; const image = (path) => new Promise((ok, no) => { const i = new Image(); i.onload = () => ok(i); i.onerror = () => no(new Error('image ' + path)); i.src = ApiClient.getUrl(path, { ApiKey: tok, v: Date.now() }); }); const diff = (a, b) => { let s = 0, n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) { for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { s += Math.abs(a[i + k] - b[i + k]); n++; } } return Math.round(s / n * 10) / 10; }; const poster = await image('Bookmarks/Clips/' + key + '/Artwork/Poster'); const thumb = await image('Bookmarks/Clips/' + key + '/Artwork/Thumb'); const v = document.createElement('video'); v.muted = true; v.preload = 'auto'; v.src = ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + key + '/Clip/File', { ApiKey: tok, download: 'false' }); await new Promise((ok, no) => { v.onloadeddata = ok; v.onerror = () => no(new Error('video')); }); const seek = (t) => new Promise((ok) => { v.onseeked = ok; v.currentTime = t; }); await seek(0); const first = pixels(v); await seek(Math.max(0, v.duration - 0.5)); const last = pixels(v); const p = pixels(poster); return { posterSize: [poster.naturalWidth, poster.naturalHeight], videoSize: [v.videoWidth, v.videoHeight], duration: Math.round(v.duration * 10) / 10, firstFrame: diff(p, first), lastFrame: diff(p, last), thumbToPoster: diff(pixels(thumb), p) }; })()

steps.name: the poster is the clip's first frame: the clip's picture size, close to frame 0 (JPEG and the decoder: under 12), and the thumb the same image
steps.message: the poster isn't the clip's first frame

steps.name: the poster is nearer frame 0 than the last frame, when those two differ
steps.message: the poster looks more like the clip's last frame than its first

steps.name: the Clips row shows the clip
the clip card's image
steps.eval: (() => { const c = [...document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide)').querySelectorAll('.jfbm-detail-clips .jfbm-rowcard')].find((x) => /clip-thumbs Heist/.test(x.textContent)); const st = c.querySelector('.cardImageContainer').style; const frame = c.querySelector('.jfbm-rowcard-frame'); return (st.backgroundImage || (frame && frame.style.backgroundImage) || '').replace(/^url\("?|"?\)$/g, '').replace(/[?&](ApiKey|api_key)=[^&]*/i, ''); })()

steps.name: the Clips row's card shows the clip's Thumb (its first frame)
steps.message: the Clips row doesn't show the clip's own thumbnail

steps.name: open My Clips on this clip
the clip's row shows its own thumbnail
My Clips shows the clip's Thumb, loaded
steps.assert: /\/Bookmarks\/Clips\/[0-9a-f]+\/Artwork\/Thumb\b/i.test(__vars.myClipsImage) && (await new Promise((ok) => { const i = document.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-row[data-jfbm-clip="' + String(__vars.bookmarkId).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase() + '"]').querySelector('.jfbm-clip-thumb img'); if (i.complete) { ok(i.naturalWidth > 0); } else { i.onload = () => ok(i.naturalWidth > 0); i.onerror = () => ok(false); } }))
steps.message: My Clips doesn't show the clip's own thumbnail

steps.name: the clip-thumbs bookmark and its clip deleted
steps.script: if (!__vars.movieId) return 0; const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); let n = 0; for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (/^clip-thumbs/.test(b.Name || '')) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); n++; } } return n;
